note: Gravel RV lot near I-70 exit 361 in Limon, built 2017; mostly monthly renters (its park rules are written for tenants: rent due on the 1st, winter heated hoses and skirting), with nights sold online. No office, restrooms or showers; no picnic tables or fire pits. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its parkwith.us booking page: 37 sites with 30/50-A, water, sewer, wifi, no restrooms; nights sold online (1-night minimum) at $45 for a 23-ft Class C (Nov 11, 2026). Confirmed hookups, 37 sites, year-round, 100-ft max (the 5 pull-throughs are 25 x 100 ft). Added pull-through, laundry false, wifi, booking (parkwith.us, 1-14 nights online), fee $45, military discount. Note rewritten to say it is mostly monthly renters.
flags: Long-stay five tests: PASS. (1) $45/night (a booking service fee may be added; at the 7% the engine lists it would be about $48, still under $50); no gateway within 40 km (Denver 124 km); not stayed. (2) Nights sold on the operator's own booking page, no application, lease or approval. (3) Minimum 1 night. (4) 5 of 37 sites offered for a November weeknight; 34 of 37 bookable online. (5) Not a home community. But it is mostly long-term: the operator's About page is a monthly-rent rulebook ('Rent and electricity are due on the 1st of each month', 'The tenant will be asked to find another place to live'), and only the 5 pull-throughs were open for a Nov 11 night.
Max length 100 ft is sourced (the 5 pull-throughs, 25 x 100 ft); the 29 back-ins are 35-70 ft and closed to Class A rigs.
Rate: $45 is a November weeknight quote for a Class C motorhome; the operator says rates don't change by season. Summer not separately quoted.
